description: A shell script containing tests for 'git stash' with '--include-untracked' and related options, including various scenarios and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file exists and is not empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or simulates time passing.
